name: Vacation Tracker: PTO & Leave
description:
Vacation Tracker brings your team's PTO data into Claude. Ask who's out next week, when public holidays land, and how to plan coverage for a sprint, campaign, or offsite. The connector reads from your existing Vacation Tracker account in real time, so answers are always current. No exports, no spreadsheet handoffs, no leaving the chat.

What you can ask:

- "Who's out next week?"
- "Find everyone on the Engineering team in our SF office."
- "I'm working on the Q3 roadmap. Give me the product team's availability through the end of September."
- "We want to run a 2-day marketing campaign in May. Check availability for Marketing and Support and suggest the best mid-week dates."
- "What public holidays fall in the next 30 days for our SF and London offices?"
- "Build a chart of the product team's time off through Q2."

Claude can chart what it finds. Build calendar views, timelines, or custom reports for projects, campaigns, or offsites. No spreadsheet required.

Vacation Tracker is the PTO management tool used by 3,500+ growing teams across Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Google Workspace. The MCP connector is included on both Core and Complete plans.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vacation Tracker: PTO & Leave to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vacation Tracker: PTO & Leave to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vacationtracker.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vacation Tracker: PTO & Leave MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vacation Tracker: PTO & Leave provides these MCP tools: find_users, get_holidays, get_leaves, and get_workspace_info.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vacation Tracker: PTO & Leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Vacation Tracker: PTO & Leave in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.

_published_faq.name: Does Vacation Tracker: PTO & Leave MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vacation Tracker: PTO & Leave requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Vacation Tracker: PTO & Leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vacation Tracker: PTO & Leave is developed by Vacation Tracker Technologies Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
